compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding.
Finding: The inline comment at line 687 of test_context_augmentation.py partially mischaracterizes the call sequence for soft_cap=1 — conflates the outer litellm.completion call (call #1, before aug loop) with the first aug-loop normal-turn call (call #2). The assertion message 'initial+normal+nudge' is accurate; only the inline comment is misleading.
File: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_context_augmentation.py
Category: hygiene

comments.body: Fixed: corrected misleading comment on line 716 of test_explicit_soft_cap_argument_takes_precedence_over_module_constant. Old comment said 'triggers nudge at aug_turn=soft_cap=1' implying calls 1-2 cause the nudge; corrected to clarify call 1 is the initial call (before aug loop), call 2 is aug_turn=0 normal turn, and the nudge actually fires at aug_turn=1 (call 3).
